content.text:
I changed `HibernateOrmProcessor` (in `extensions/hibernate-orm/deployment`) so the dev-mode `HibernateOrmDevIntegrator` is no longer referenced as a literal class. It is now registered with `recorderContext.classProxy(HibernateOrmDevIntegrator.class.getName())`, the same way service-file integrators already are. Before, the build step baked the deployment-side `Class` object into the recorded bytecode. In remote dev with a mutable jar, that class came from a plain `URLClassLoader`, so it was a different `Integrator` type from the one the `QuarkusClassLoader` sees. That mismatch caused the `ClassCastException`. With the proxy, the class is looked up by name at runtime through the correct classloader.

I couldn't compile or test it. Maven fails offline because the Develocity extension isn't cached, so the edit is unchecked. I didn't reproduce the issue (no mutable-jar remote-dev setup), and I didn't run the axiomengine graph because none was built for this repo, so I used grep.

`SchemaManagementIntegrator` is registered in the same dev-mode block and I left it as a literal class. It lives in the runtime module, so it should be on the same classloader as `Integrator`, but I didn't confirm that.
